g.title: TF_WFDELEGATIONS
g.text: Identify the user for which the delegation has been requested.
The priority to consider when more than one delegated is defined.
The start date of the delegation.
The end date of the delegation.
Indicates if the delegation will be applied to all task or on a specific scope.
On custom scope determines if all conditions are applied.
Indicate if the delegation is anonymous.
When activating, assign any pending task already existing in my queue.
When de-activating, take back any task still pending.
Indicates if the delegation has been processed.
The last activation date of the delegation.
